item.title: Heart attack and stroke risk detectable decades in advance
item.description:
📝 Traditional risk factors, such as high blood pressure and cholesterol, have been widely linked to the risk of disease. Patterns in blood biomarkers also revealed early differences between those who went on to develop cardiovascular disease compared with those who didn’t. Further research should also explore whether incorporating non-traditional risk factors could help to improve the estimation of cardiovascular disease risk, they add.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ed.ac.uk/news/heart-attack-and-stroke-risk-detectable-decades-in-advance
